<script>
document.querySelectorAll("a.obf").forEach(function (a) {
  a.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (a.dataset.done) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var addr = atob(a.dataset.u) + "@" + atob(a.dataset.d);
    a.textContent = addr;
    a.href = "mailto:" + addr;
    a.dataset.done = "1";
  });
});
